tooltip.elementalcrystals.inert: An inert crystal. Right-click to awaken it.
tooltip.elementalcrystals.fire.passive: Immune to fire and lava damage.
tooltip.elementalcrystals.fire.active: Ignite Burst - engulfs nearby enemies in flame and empowers your strength. (20s cooldown)
tooltip.elementalcrystals.frost.passive: Immune to freezing; chills nearby enemies.
tooltip.elementalcrystals.frost.active: Freeze Burst - roots and damages nearby enemies. (30s cooldown)
tooltip.elementalcrystals.frost.tradeoff: Permanently slowed while the crystal is active.
tooltip.elementalcrystals.lightning.pass: Immune to lightning strikes; may chain a shock when struck.
tooltip.elementalcrystals.lightning.acti: Storm Dash - dash forward and shock enemies on landing. (15s cooldown)
tooltip.elementalcrystals.lightning.trad: Costs hunger and deals self-damage on use.
tooltip.elementalcrystals.void_element.p: Grants night vision and a slow health trickle.
tooltip.elementalcrystals.void_element.a: Void Siphon - drains life from nearby enemies to heal you. (25s cooldown)
tooltip.elementalcrystals.void_element.t: Leaves you blinded and hungry afterward.
message.elementalcrystals.awakened: Your crystal awakens with the power of %s!
message.elementalcrystals.on_cooldown: The crystal is still recharging (%s s left).
